title: Traps and fishing
summary: Set several traps where animals clearly travel, and leave as little sign of yourself as you can.

blocks.warn: In normal times New York requires a trapping licence, sets trapping seasons, bans snares for trapping, limits trap types, and requires traps to be checked at least once every 24 hours in the Southern Zone (every 24 or 48 hours in the Northern Zone, depending on area and trap). Fishing needs a licence from age 16, lines must not be left unattended, and fish traps may only be used for baitfish. Other states have their own rules.

list: Set traps where you can see animals pass: runs, trails, droppings, burrow openings, and feeding or watering spots. Set them where the trail narrows, or narrow it yourself with a funnel of sticks.
Set several. A few well-placed traps can catch more than one person hunting.
Leave as little sign of yourself as you can: clear away fresh dirt, don’t cut live plants nearby, and handle traps as little as possible. Human scent alarms animals; mud masks it. Don’t use urine.
Simple snare: a noose of wire anchored firmly, big enough to slip over the animal’s head but never low enough for it to step a foot into. Wire works better than cord, which can loosen and slip off.

blocks.cap: Simple snare: a noose of wire anchored firmly, big enough to slip over the animal’s head. Twigs funnel the animal in.

list: Squirrel pole: lean a long pole against a tree squirrels use and fix several small wire nooses along it.

blocks.cap: Squirrels take the easy route up a leaning pole.

list: Figure-4 deadfall: three notched sticks hold up a rock or log heavy enough to kill the animal at once, and bait on the trigger stick drops it. Practise setting the trigger first. Keep your hands and body out from under the weight while setting it.

blocks.cap: Figure-4 deadfall. Disturbing the bait trips the trigger and drops the weight.

list: Gorge hook: a short sliver of bone or hardwood, sharpened at both ends and tied at the middle. Bait it lengthwise. Let the fish swallow it deep before you pull, so it sets itself in the throat; don’t jerk the line.
Fish trap: a funnel-shaped basket of lashed sticks that fish swim into but struggle to find their way out of.
Fish often feed heavily before a storm and seldom just after one, while the water is muddy. Light often draws them at night.

blocks.p: Cleaning and cooking fish and game is in Field dressing game.
